lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Chapter heading.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Chapter title. Leave a clean beat before story begins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Three days after the shifted alley, they found the second one.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage opened in the middle of a functioning street while a water-seller was still arguing with a customer about measures. One moment the wall was ordinary brick. The next it had a dark mouth in it, narrow and already breathing cooler air.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The water-seller glanced toward it once.

lines.speaker: Water-Seller
lines.text: I filled the cup to the line.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: People moved around the opening without slowing. A woman carrying reeds shifted her basket to avoid brushing the dark threshold. A pair of boys chased a wooden hoop past it and did not look inside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: That was how the outer districts survived: by deciding certain things were someone else's problem.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg stopped the nearest donkey with a hand on its neck.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The donkey leaned away from the passage hard enough to tighten its tether. Its ears flattened. A tremor moved beneath the skin of its neck.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She was already approaching the opening, eyes moving over the lintel, the floor, the edges where ordinary masonry had folded around something older.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun did not wait for discussion.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She was three steps inside before the rest of them finished looking at one another.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: She does know we usually check whether the floor exists.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek followed last, the way he had started doing without deciding to.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark under the linen gave one low pulse and then went quiet again, as though it had registered the place and found nothing worth arguing about yet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He paused at the threshold and marked the wall with chalk.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The line appeared pale against the dark brick.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: For an instant, another line showed beneath it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Cut into the brick rather than drawn.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then it vanished under his fingers.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek looked back at the street.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No one had noticed four people disappear into the wall.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage was shorter than the first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ten steps in, the street noise dulled.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The walls were smooth and undecorated, their bricks laid without mortar. The ceiling sloped downward until BAH-lahg had to lower his head. The cold there was not the natural coolness of buried rooms. It gathered around their ankles first, then climbed slowly, as if rising from deep water.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Then why does it smell flooded?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage smelled of clay after rain.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: And beneath that, faint but unmistakable, the sour mineral stink of stagnant water.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At twenty-three, his boot struck something.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A thin groove crossed the floor from wall to wall. It was too straight to be a crack and too shallow to be a drain.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg tapped the groove with his spear.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The sound came back from below.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A second sound followed a moment later.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: As though something under the floor had answered.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage ended in a low chamber with a single stone basin set into the floor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The room was circular, though the bricks had been laid in straight courses, each one narrowing slightly to imitate the curve. The ceiling domed overhead. Dark stains radiated from the center like the traces of smoke from a fire that had burned downward instead of up.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Around its rim someone had cut a ring of names in the old script—dozens of them, perhaps more. Most were crossed out so thoroughly that the stone itself looked wounded.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Some had been struck through once.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Others had been attacked repeatedly until the letters disappeared beneath grooves and chips.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One name near the far edge was still clear.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun crouched beside it and went still.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her hand hovered above the carving.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek moved beside her and studied the letters.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The kind of name that belonged to a potter, a dock worker, or someone who sold onions in the lower market. The kind of name the city usually did not bother remembering long enough to carve into stone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her finger hovered over the first sign without touching it.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: The edges haven't taken dust yet.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek crouched and blew lightly across the carving.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Fine powder lifted from the older names.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg tested the walls with the butt of his spear.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She had already pulled a scrap of parchment from her satchel.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: But I'm not leaving it unrecorded.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She copied the name with quick, exact strokes.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It had been cut from a single block of dark stone, harder than the limestone commonly used in the lower districts. The interior was shallow and polished. No drainage hole. No channels. Nothing to explain what it was meant to hold.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He ran the edge of his awl around the inside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A dark residue gathered at the tip.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The brackish taste from his dream returned so suddenly that his throat closed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg peered into the empty basin.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek looked at the dark residue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek wiped the awl clean on a scrap of cloth.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun looked around the sealed chamber.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: Then perhaps we stop asking how the water entered and leave before it remembers.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo had moved to the opposite side of the basin.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She traced one of the crossed-out names with the point of her knife.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: These cuts weren't made by the same person.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Different depths. Different tools. Some used chisels. Some used blades.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She pointed to a name almost completely destroyed.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: This one was scratched away slowly.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The marks did not look administrative.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: Or it was only just added.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The lamp flame bent toward the basin.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: All four of them watched it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun folded the parchment and slipped it into her satchel.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Its polished interior reflected the lamp, Ninsun's hands, the lower edge of his own face.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It did not pour from a crack or seep through the sides. One moment the basin was dry. The next, a thin layer of dark liquid covered the bottom.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Exactly as it had tasted in the dream.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark beneath his linen warmed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Beneath them, pale lines emerged as if carved into the bottom of the stone.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They appeared beneath the water, crowding over one another, too many to read.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Then one separated from the rest.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The letters floated beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Another woman stared up from the basin.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her hair hung wet against her cheeks.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg moved between her and the basin.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The basin made a faint sound.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A breath drawn through closed teeth.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The uncrossed name on the rim darkened.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Moisture filled the grooves of the letters.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek watched the first stroke of the name deepen.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek caught her wrist before her fingers touched the carving.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The crack widened across the first sign.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The next groove formed across the second sign.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Stone dust curled from the cut, though no tool touched it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun twisted free and pressed the parchment against her chest.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.note: Short attribution/action beat; keep tight to surrounding dialogue.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A voice rose from the water.

lines.speaker: The City
lines.note: The City speaking: not fully human. Whispered, wet, close.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.note: CITY MIMIC of Ninsun's voice from the basin: wet, slightly delayed, not quite human.

lines.speaker: The City
lines.note: The walls repeat the name from different places. The City speaking: not fully human. Whispered, wet, close.

lines.speaker: The City
lines.note: The walls repeat the name from different places. The City speaking: not fully human. Whispered, wet, close.

lines.speaker: The City
lines.note: The walls repeat the name from different places. The City speaking: not fully human. Whispered, wet, close.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Each repetition came from a different place.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her sister's face appeared beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: This time the woman's lips moved.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek tightened his grip on her wrist.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The woman beneath the water raised one hand.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her palm pressed against the underside of the surface.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The water surged over the rim.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg shoved her toward the passage.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The black liquid struck the stone floor and spread in a perfect circle.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It bent around them in four narrow streams, each one curving toward a different person.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The stream aimed at him stopped at the edge of his sandal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark beneath his linen flared.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The water rose into a thin upright shape.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: It pointed toward the satchel holding his father's journal.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg first, pushing Ninsun ahead of him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo followed with her knife drawn, though there was nothing visible to cut.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek remained at the chamber threshold long enough to look back.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: But a new name had appeared beside it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek stepped back into the passage.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They reached the groove in the floor.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: As BAH-lahg crossed it, the echoing tap sounded from below.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: This time it did not wait for his spear.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The floor shifted under Zeek's boots.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The passage behind them began to narrow.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bricks slid outward from the walls, closing the space course by course. En-HEH-doo twisted sideways and forced herself past the first constriction. BAH-lahg caught Ninsun beneath the arms and hauled her through the next.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The strap tightened across his chest.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: One brick had pushed through the leather flap and caught the journal beneath it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The mark on his palm burned.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo grabbed the satchel strap from the other side.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He drove the bronze awl into the mortar beside the brick and levered downward. The mortar cracked. Black water leaked from the seam and ran over his hand.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Withdrew into the wall as though reconsidering.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: En-HEH-doo pulled him through the narrowing gap.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They stumbled into the street together.

lines.speaker: Water-Seller
lines.text: I measured it in front of you.

lines.speaker: Water Customer
lines.text: With your thumb in the cup.

lines.speaker: Water-Seller
lines.text: My thumb is not that large.

lines.speaker: Water Customer
lines.text: It has always been that large.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Behind them, the dark opening narrowed.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The chamber was no longer visible. Only a strip of black passage remained.

lines.speaker: The City
lines.note: The City speaking: not fully human. Whispered, wet, close.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: BAH-lahg blocked her with the shaft of his spear.

lines.speaker: The City
lines.note: The City speaking: not fully human. Whispered, wet, close.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The water-seller's customer shoved a cup into his chest and stalked away.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No one else looked at the four of them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The scrap of parchment was damp.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The name remained in her handwriting.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Beneath it, a second line had appeared.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A NAME SPOKEN IS A DOOR LEFT OPEN.
lines.note: Written text (ledger/inscription/journal, not in Bel-iddin's hand). Cold, deliberate read.

lines.speaker: Enhedu
lines.text: That sounds less like advice than a threat.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: You asked whether I would tell anyone.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: Because the moment I do, someone with a better title will decide it belongs in a locked drawer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She tucked the parchment deeper into the satchel.

lines.speaker: Ninsun
lines.text: I'd rather it stay on a piece of paper I control.

lines.speaker: Balag
lines.text: That's either smart or the kind of thinking that gets people buried under better titles.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: They stepped fully back into the ordinary flow of the street.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The dark mouth in the wall had become a shallow recess. A basket seller had already set three empty crates against it. Any local would have sworn the recess had always been there.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Zeek flexed his left hand inside the wet linen.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Ninsun walked ahead, one hand resting over her satchel.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He considered telling her about the second name on the basin.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: He considered how quickly the chamber had learned her voice.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Behind them, in a room the city no longer admitted existed, one name remained uncrossed.
